name: ab_cp_tier_fair_deadline
$comment: Defect #2: the gossip round budget is CARRIER-clock time and mango's carrier clock is SIMULATION time, so every iteration costs a message round-trip and the whole 4-tier cascade gets round/iter = 2.0/0.2 = ~10 iterations TOTAL. Measured on the 47-CP el_dependent feeder: tier 0 consumed 10-11 of them and tiers 1..3 then broke at iteration 0 - no optimisation at all.

Identified as a UNITS bug, not an algorithm difference: offline on a wall-clock SimpleCarrier the same 2.0/0.2 never binds, the cascade finishes in ms, and gossip matches the replicated kernel to 0.001-0.004 on both real fleets.
enable_cp_gossip_tier_fair_deadline splits the SAME overall bound into cumulative per-tier deadlines, so every tier gets a slice and a tier that converges early hands its unused time on.

Arms: default(on) / off(today) / lexicographic(upper reference - the replicated kernel has no message cost and gets admm_max_iters=200 PER TIER). Reference from ab_cp_gossip_vs_lexicographic: gas_dependent gossip 1.773 -> lexicographic 1.893 PWSF, gas served 0.383 -> 0.677.
Runs on top of the mirror fix, so el_dependent's 47-CP fleet is whole for the first time.
Judge on: the 'timed out at tier N iter 0' pattern in run.log, outcomes__cp_generation, served_by_sector, PWSF.
